Your readers cross genres with you, from literary fiction to folk-horror crime and, soon, science fiction. Right now, though, there's no newsletter on the site and the latest news item dates from 2022. A simple reader-retention plan, with a sign-up and a short sequence introducing Burrowhead readers to The Comet Seekers and The Growing Season, would keep them with you until the new sci-fi series arrives.

I'd be happy to sketch a complimentary sample of that sequence.

Would you like to see it?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs

leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi Carrie,

I'm Roland Jacobs, a designer and book services specialist who helps authors present and promote their books.

I've been reading about Small Town Joy and Carrie Kills A Man on your site. Gutter's line about a 'mixtape lovingly assembled by a friend's cool, knowledgeable older sister' sums up Small Town Joy perfectly, and it's great that Carrie Kills A Man has found a new home with Cipher Press.

The mixtape idea gave me a thought for a sales push. Small Town Joy is an ideal present for music fans, so I'd pair it with a shareable playlist of the artists in the book, a few quote-led graphics, and a 'two books, one voice' offer alongside the memoir, aimed at record shops, music communities and your Bluesky and Instagram followers ahead of the gifting season.

I'd be glad to make a complimentary concept sample of the graphics and playlist page.

Would you like to see it?

Cheers,
Roland Jacobs
